name: Chat Icon
author: Cross

sections.description: The Chat Icon Plugin allows users to display a chat icon in the bottom right corner of their WordPress website. When clicked, it redirects users to a specified URL for chatting or support.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/chat-icon directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings > Chat Icon and set the chat URL.

short_description: This plugin displays a chat icon at the bottom right of your website that redirects users to a specified chat URL.
